templates.name: Search deals via search form with filters
templates.description: Use the Travelzoo search form to find {deal_type} deals in {destination} during {when} (optionally guests), then apply filters/sort such as {filters}.
steps: Click 'What type of deals?' and choose the deal type (or navigate via category link)
Enter or select the destination in 'Where?'
Open 'When?' and choose a season, month or dates
Open Filter, select desired filters/sort options and click DONE
Optionally open a result or view on map

templates.name: Browse category deals page and filter/sort
templates.description: Open the {category} deals page from site navigation and apply {filters}/{sort} to list deals.
steps: Click a top navigation link (e.g. Last-Minute Deals, Cruises, Vacations)
Select sort order and/or filter options
